mapper.select: SELECT r.chat_room_idx AS chatRoomIdx, r.user1_idx AS user1Idx, r.user2_idx AS user2Idx, CASE WHEN r.user1_idx = #{myIdx} THEN r.user2_idx ELSE r.user1_idx END AS otherIdx, u.user_name AS otherName, -- 상대방 타입에 따라 해당 테이블의 PHOTO 추출, 없으면 기본 이미지 CASE WHEN u.user_type = 'COACH' THEN NVL(co.photo, 'default_profile.png') WHEN u.user_type = 'COMPANY' THEN NVL(cp.photo, 'default_profile.png') ELSE 'default_profile.png' END AS otherPhoto, u.user_type AS otherType, r.last_message AS lastMessage, CAST(r.last_message_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS lastMessageAt, CASE WHEN r.user1_idx = #{myIdx} THEN NVL(r.unread_count1, 0) ELSE NVL(r.unread_count2, 0) END AS unreadCount FROM chat_room r JOIN users u ON u.user_idx = CASE WHEN r.user1_idx = #{myIdx} THEN r.user2_idx ELSE r.user1_idx END -- 코치 정보 조인 LEFT JOIN coach co ON u.user_idx = co.user_idx -- 컴퍼니 정보 조인 LEFT JOIN company cp ON u.user_idx = cp.user_idx WHERE #{myIdx} IN (r.user1_idx, r.user2_idx) AND ( (r.user1_idx = #{myIdx} AND NVL(r.left1_yn, 'N') = 'N') OR (r.user2_idx = #{myIdx} AND NVL(r.left2_yn, 'N') = 'N') ) ORDER BY r.last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST, r.chat_room_idx DESC

SELECT r.chat_room_idx AS chatRoomIdx, r.user1_idx AS user1Idx, r.user2_idx AS user2Idx, CASE WHEN r.user1_idx = #{myIdx} THEN r.user2_idx ELSE r.user1_idx END AS otherIdx, u.user_name AS otherName, 'default_profile.png' AS otherPhoto, u.user_type AS otherType, r.last_message AS lastMessage, CAST(r.last_message_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS lastMessageAt, CASE WHEN r.user1_idx = #{myIdx} THEN NVL(r.unread_count1,0) ELSE NVL(r.unread_count2,0) END AS unreadCount FROM chat_room r JOIN users u ON u.user_idx = CASE WHEN r.user1_idx = #{myIdx} THEN r.user2_idx ELSE r.user1_idx END WHERE r.chat_room_idx = #{roomIdx} AND #{myIdx} IN (r.user1_idx, r.user2_idx) AND ( (r.user1_idx = #{myIdx} AND NVL(r.left1_yn,'N') = 'N') OR (r.user2_idx = #{myIdx} AND NVL(r.left2_yn,'N') = 'N') )
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_room SET last_message = #{lastMessage}, last_message_at = SYSDATE WHERE chat_room_idx = #{roomIdx}

UPDATE chat_room SET unread_count1 = CASE WHEN user1_idx = #{myIdx} THEN 0 ELSE unread_count1 END, unread_count2 = CASE WHEN user2_idx = #{myIdx} THEN 0 ELSE unread_count2 END WHERE chat_room_idx = #{roomIdx} AND #{myIdx} IN (user1_idx, user2_idx)

UPDATE chat_room SET unread_count1 = CASE WHEN user1_idx != #{myIdx} THEN NVL(unread_count1,0)+1 ELSE unread_count1 END, unread_count2 = CASE WHEN user2_idx != #{myIdx} THEN NVL(unread_count2,0)+1 ELSE unread_count2 END WHERE chat_room_idx = #{roomIdx} AND #{myIdx} IN (user1_idx, user2_idx)
mapper.select: SELECT chat_room_idx FROM chat_room WHERE (user1_idx = #{myIdx} AND user2_idx = #{targetIdx}) OR (user1_idx = #{targetIdx} AND user2_idx = #{myIdx})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_room (chat_room_idx, user1_idx, user2_idx, created_at) VALUES (seq_chat_room.NEXTVAL, #{myIdx}, #{targetIdx}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_room SET left1_yn = CASE WHEN user1_idx = #{myIdx} THEN 'Y' ELSE left1_yn END, left2_yn = CASE WHEN user2_idx = #{myIdx} THEN 'Y' ELSE left2_yn END WHERE chat_room_idx = #{roomIdx} AND #{myIdx} IN (user1_idx, user2_idx)

UPDATE chat_room SET left1_yn = CASE WHEN user1_idx = #{myIdx} THEN 'N' ELSE left1_yn END, left2_yn = CASE WHEN user2_idx = #{myIdx} THEN 'N' ELSE left2_yn END WHERE chat_room_idx = #{roomIdx} AND #{myIdx} IN (user1_idx, user2_idx)
mapper.select: select count(*) from chat_room where chat_room_idx = #{chat_room_idx} and ( (user1_idx = #{user_idx} and left2_yn = 'Y') or (user2_idx = #{user_idx} and left1_yn = 'Y') )
mapper.delete: delete from match where (user1_idx = #{user_idx} and user2_idx = #{target_idx}) or (user1_idx = #{target_idx} and user2_idx = #{user_idx})
mapper.select: select match_applicant, is_match from match where (user1_idx = #{my_idx} and user2_idx = #{target_idx}) or (user1_idx = #{target_idx} and user2_idx = #{my_idx})
